query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `curationFeedback` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `curatedThoughtId` int NOT NULL,
  `isHelpful` boolean,
  `feedback` text,
  `suggestedImprovements` text,
  `usageContext` varchar(255),
  `commercializedAs` varchar(100),
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `curationFeedback_curatedThoughtId_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`curatedThoughtId`) REFERENCES `curatedThoughts`(`id`)
);
